turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's start with why my son found out about a zero from his phone in the middle of class.
Go ahead, Hale. I'm writing down that the zero went in before anyone called me.
I have 140 students. I don't have time to be cross-examined by every parent with a law degree.
"Cross-examined" is your word, Hale. Who decided on the zero, and was my son spoken to before it went into the gradebook?
You don't get to talk to me like I'm on the stand.
Then don't make me do it. Your own procedure says a parent is contacted before any mark is entered, and nobody called me. Tell me what the zero rests on.
